title: Differential of cumulative-product cochain evaluation
statement: Let $G$ be a compact Hausdorff topological group in universe $u$ and $N$ a topological integer representation in coefficient universe $\max(u,s)$ with discrete coefficient topology. For the concrete additive evaluation maps $e_n$ of [def-sc-homogeneous-cochain-evaluation], every $n\geq0$, $x\in H^n$ and $g\in G^{n+1}$ satisfy $e_{n+1}(dx)(g)=\rho(g_0)e_n(x)(g_1,\ldots,g_n)+\sum_{k=0}^n(-1)^{k+1}e_n(x)(\operatorname{contract}_k(g))$. Here contract multiplies adjacent coordinates when $k<n$ and drops the final coordinate when $k=n$. Neither open stabilizers nor bijectivity are required.

proof.text: Induct on m to prove E_(m+1)(d_m f)(h) is the sum over i in Fin(m+1) of (-1)^i E_m(f)(h with coordinate i omitted). The base differential is constant insertion. At the next step, d is constant insertion minus the previous d applied pointwise. Split the sum into its first term and successor-index terms; evaluate the first term on the tail, and use the induction hypothesis on the remaining terms. Fin.succ_succAbove_succ identifies the omissions after taking the tail, and multiplying by -1 shifts their signs.

proof.text: Apply TopRep.homogeneousCochains.d_apply and the alternating-omission formula at Fin.partialProd g. Split off omission zero. Fin.partialProd_succ' identifies this tuple as g_0 times the cumulative products of the tail, and diagonal equivariance supplies the action term. For each remaining term, Fin.partialProd_contractNth identifies omission k+1 with the partial products of contract_k(g), with the same sign (-1)^(k+1). Sum these equalities. The base-degree formula is included in the induction.

theorem homogeneousCochainEvaluation_differential [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G]
    (N : TopRep.{max u s} ℤ G) [DiscreteTopology N.V]
    (n : ℕ) (x : (TopRep.homogeneousCochains N).X n) (g : Fin (n + 1) → G) :
    homogeneousCochainEvaluation N (n + 1)
        (((TopRep.homogeneousCochains N).d n (n + 1)).hom x) g =
      N.ρ (g 0) (homogeneousCochainEvaluation N n x (fun k ↦ g k.succ)) +
        ∑ k : Fin (n + 1),
          (-1 : ℤ) ^ (k.val + 1) •
            homogeneousCochainEvaluation N n x (Fin.contractNth k (· * ·) g)
